notes.title: Color Zone 1.2 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007091/1dc5c6e96be02a39d8ba078018813947271696ed.gif
What's new:
Implemented Gameplay Ability System (GAS)
Added Rocket Marker. (Indicator for launching rockets with LMB at nearest enemy.)
Ability to Stun Everyone (Previously it was only the closest enemy.)
Added in-game sensitivity setting.
More efficient network traffic with GAS.
Game time changed to 2.5 minutes.
Cooldown time of skills has changed.

notes.title: Color Zone 1.1 Update - Offline Mode
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=q-tEe4w-pI8;full][/previewyoutube]
In this update, offline play mode has been added to the game. You will be able to play with 5 bots.
The ability to change the difficulty of the game mode, new map and character selection screen will be added in the next updates. Dedicated server infrastructure continues to be developed.
Please report bugs and issues, have fun.
